continuity_constraints.rule: A handling action that starts in one shot completes without a temporal jump; no repeated or reversed motion across a cut.
The handled object keeps one identity across cuts; identical-looking distractors never substitute for it.
Cuts play in source order within each take; the sequence never runs time backwards.

cut_ranges.reason: Keep the complete handling beat from the 001 take; the action must read in one span.
Keep the object-present span from the longer take after handles; the object must stay identifiable.

expected_source_moments.description: Handling action in the 001 take; objects are handled but no action gold labels exist yet.
Object-present span in the longer 001 take; objects occur but no object gold labels exist yet.

brief.intent: Cut a short visual sequence from the daylight 001 takes that keeps one handling action legible and one handled object continuously identifiable across cuts.

preference_rubric.description: The handling action reads clearly; the viewer can follow what the hands do.
The object stays the same object across every cut.
The sequence moves without lingering or rushing the action.
